mappings.architectural_rationale: Restricts tool invocation to an explicit allowlist before inspecting parameters. Prevents unauthorized method execution, reflection attacks, and wildcard dispatch.
Guarantees type safety prior to tool handler invocation. Prevents runtime exceptions, SQL/command injection vectors, and malformed payload propagation.
Preserves client request IDs across asynchronous boundaries and encapsulates computation results within standardized JSON-RPC success structures.

mappings.lesson_concept: 5.8 Security & 5.16 Protocol Features (Standard Method Resolution Error)
mappings.architectural_rationale: Provides deterministic, structured failure feedback for missing/unsupported tools without leaking internal server implementation details.
Signals parameter schema violations (-32602) to the calling agent so the LLM or client can self-correct inputs without terminating transport connection.

mappings.input_or_output: Invariant: Failed calls result in 0 tool executions
mappings.architectural_rationale: Failed invocations halt processing immediately, guaranteeing no unintended state mutations, cascading tool executions, or secondary side effects occur.
